text.p: Gold miner Resolute Samantha Ltd said on Wednesday that it expected steady earnings and gold production in the year to June 30, 1997 compared with 1995/96.

"I think next year, at this stage, it looks like being the same as this year, because all four gold mines are working," Resolute's director of exploration, Ross Kennedy, told reporters in answer to a question about earnings and production.

On July 28, Resolute said it expected to report a net profit of A$32 million in 1995/96 compared with A$11.12 million in 1994/95. Resolute has yet to formally report its 1995/96 result. Resolute produced 293,744 ounces of gold in 1995/96.
"Because our production is going to be about the same, unless there is some dramatic drop or rise in the price of gold, we should have the same sort of year," Kennedy said.
Resolute shares closed two cents down at A$2.70.
